title: Existence and quantity
grammar: There is/are, Some/Any, How much/How many
function: Describe what exists in a place

phases.name: Presentation
phases.content: In this unit you will learn how to say what exists in a place and talk about quantities using there is/are, some/any and how much/how many.

phases.name: Discovery
phases.content: Read these sentences. There is a cat on the sofa. There are two books on the table. Is there any milk? How many apples do you want? Notice: there is for singular, there are for plural.

phases.name: Guided practice
phases.explanation: With plural nouns we use There are.

phases.name: Free practice
phases.prompt: Describe your living room: what furniture is there?

phases.name: Mini-test
phases.explanation: Money is uncountable, so we use How much.
